messages.subject: histogram & values inside the bars
parts:
Hi,

have anybody a hint/starting point getting the frequency values of
histogram inside the "bars" in ggplot2 - similar to the
lattice example below (not perfect just an example).

many thanks ,
Christian

#Example data
dframe <- data.frame(typ= sample(c("t1","t2","t3"),1000,replace=T))
dframe$segment <- sample(c("seg1","seg2","seg3","seg4"),1000,replace=T)

##ggplot without values in text
p_segment <- ggplot(dframe, aes(x = typ))
p_segment + geom_histogram(fill=c("grey80"),aes(y= ..count.. /
sum(..count..),colour=segment)) + scale_y_continuous("Anteil in
%",formatter = "percent") + facet_wrap(~segment) + xlab("Segment") +
opts(title="Segmente im Vergleich") + BaseTheme(base_size=12) +
scale_color_hue("Segment",l=70,c=100)


#lattice version
histogram(~typ|segment,data=dframe,layout=c(2,2),
xlab="xlabel",ylab="Share of Users in %",main="title",
#mycolors = sample(colors(), 2),
scales=list(x=list(rot=45)),#breaks=ncut,
mycolors = c("skyblue","lightgreen","rosybrown","red"),
panel = function(x,col, mycolors,...) {
panel.histogram(x, col = mycolors[panel.number()],...)
nn <- round((table(x)/length(x)),3)*100
panel.text(paste(nn," %"),
x = seq_along(nn),
y = current.panel.limits()$y[1]+.35,
pos = 3,
cex=0.7)
})

messages.subject: Re: histogram & values inside the bars
parts: Hi Christian, it's easier if you summarize the data first

dframe.summary <- ddply(dframe, .(segment), function(df) round((table(df$typ)/length(df$typ)),3))
dframe.summary <- melt(dframe.summary , id="segment")
names(dframe.summary)<-c("segment", "typ", "value")

##ggplot with values in text
library(ggplot2)
p_segment <- ggplot(dframe.summary, aes(x = typ, y= value)) + geom_histogram(fill=c("grey80"),aes(colour=segment)) + scale_y_continuous("Anteil in %",formatter = "percent") + facet_wrap(~segment)  +  xlab("Segment") + opts(title="Segmente im Vergleich") + scale_color_hue("Segment",l=70,c=100) +geom_text(aes(label=paste(value*100, "%", sep=""), y=value), vjust=1)

Luciano
